title: Effect of Gender Fair Job Description on Generative AI Images

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images of STEM and non-STEM occupations using prompts with different linguistic gender forms (German generic masculine, German pair form, and English), then manually classifying the depicted individuals as male, female, or unknown and comparing the distributions using Chi-Square tests.
Categorizing the individuals generated in the occupational images into perceived age groups (younger than thirty, between thirty and fifty, and older than fifty) to evaluate age representation.
Evaluating the racial and ethnic representation in the generated occupational images by classifying depicted individuals as perceived white, Asian, or non-Asian people of color (PoC).
